title: Page 21
transc:
Norfolk Feb 8th 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. M.
Alvord a note just received
from General Wessels Plymouth dated
Feb'y seventh twelve m says
the enemy gathering at Halifax
threaten him with flat boats
having guns mounted they come
from lees army he asks
help especially for gun boats
as his are absent signed
Edward a wild brig general
R O Brien


Ft Monroe Feb 8 . 1864
Adm'l Lee Newports News
Three forty P M I forward
subjoined copy of a telegram just
received Can you aid us period
Norfolk Eighth to Clifton a note
just received from General Wessels Plymouth
dated Feby seventh twelve M. says
the Saco gathering at Halifax threaten
him with flat boats having Hemps
mounted they come from Lees army
He asks help especially for Hungers
as his are absent signed Edward
A Wild Brig General sign Clifton
Geo D Sheldon
